29. [029] Iris Novak: The corrected alert date supersedes the earlier date.

32. [032] Lena Price: Lena Price will own the support handoff instead of Kenji Sato, keeping the due date 2026-11-04; Kenji Sato is released.
33. [033] Kenji Sato: Confirmed: I am released from delivery and remain available only for questions.
34. [034] Mae Okafor: I will archive the reconciled evidence bundle by 2026-11-10.

36. [036] Arun Bose: We decided to keep one launch channel. This is a decision only; channel setup is not assigned.
37. [037] Kenji Sato: I will publish the customer-blocking escalation matrix by 2026-11-09.

40. [040] Iris Novak: Treat the fallback-review statement as ambiguity, not as an action item.
41. [041] Arun Bose: I will circulate the final ownership table by 2026-11-10.
42. [042] Lena Price: The ownership table must show the reassignment and exclude the withdrawn training session.
43. [043] Pavel Cruz: Nobody should create a second pager rotation; the existing roster remains authoritative.
44. [044] Zoe Hart: If the retest fails, the exception stays conditional and is not silently approved.
45. [045] Iris Novak: I will authorize recovery launch only after the critical credential escrow review closes, with a target of 2026-11-10.

47. [047] Arun Bose: The old prototype checklist was completed last month and appears here only as a distractor.
48. [048] Iris Novak: Final recap: retain explicit commitments with their latest owners, dates, conditions, and statuses.
49. [049] Arun Bose: This transcript is the complete experimental meeting record; side documents are not evidence.
